descripcion_geo: Roman province in northwest Asia Minor on the shores of the Black Sea. Paul tried to go there but was prevented by the Spirit.

historias.titulo: The Spirit prevents Paul from going to Bithynia
historias.descripcion: Paul tries to enter Bithynia but 'the Spirit of Jesus did not allow it'; The Macedonian's vision redirects him to Europe.

historias.titulo: Peter's letter to the believers of Bithynia
historias.descripcion: Peter addresses his first letter to the 'elect' of several provinces, including Bithynia; There are Christian communities there.

historias.titulo: Pliny the Younger and the Christians of Bithynia
historias.descripcion: Roman governor Pliny the Younger writes to Emperor Trajan about Christians in Bithynia: pagan testimony to the growth of the Church.

personajes.descripcion: He tried to go to Bithynia; the Spirit redirected him toward Macedonia.
He addressed his first letter to the believers of Bithynia and other provinces of Asia Minor.
His letters to Trajan about the Christians in Bithynia are the first detailed Roman testimony of early Christianity.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Bithynia: relevant region in the NT world.

mitos.nombre: The Spirit closes a door and opens Europe

cristianismo.descripcion: The redirection of Paul in Bithynia is a paradigm of divine providence in the mission: a closed door opens another towards Europe.
